title: Protocol for constructing large size human antibody heavy chain variable domain (VH) library and selection of SARS-CoV-2 neutralizing antibody domains
protocol: Dissolve the primers with ddH2O and adjust the concentration to 10 μM.
Assemble the VH with PCR (Figure 3A).
PCR amplify FR1, CDR1, CDR2, FR3 and CDR3 separately using High Fidelity PCR Master kit.
Run all PCR samples on a 2% agarose gel to verify the size of PCR products.
Purify the target bands from the agarose gel using QIAquick Gel Extraction Kit.
Perform overlapping PCR to assemble full-length VH with FR1, CDR1, CDR2, FR3, and CDR3 DNA as templates.
Use ALL-F and ALL-R primers for the overlapping PCR process.
Digest pComb3X plasmid and VH gene repertoires with SfiI restriction enzyme in PCR tubes at 50°C for 12 hours.
Run all the digested DNA with 1% agarose gel.
Verify the size and purity of digested products from the agarose gel.
Purify the digested products using QIAquick Gel Extraction Kit.
Ligate purified VH fragments to pComb3X vector at a molar ratio of 3:1.
Incubate ligation mixture at 16°C for 60 hours.
Perform small-scale pilot experiments with 1% agarose gel at 24, 48 and 60 hours if degradation is detected.
Choose the time point with no significant degradation for large scale ligation.
Recover ligation DNA using DNA Clean & Concentrator-5 kit according to manufacturer’s protocol.
Load each column with 5 μg of ligation DNA.
Elute recovered DNA with 6 μL ddH2O.
Determine the DNA concentration by Nanodrop Lite.
Add 1 μg ligation DNA into each vial of TG1 cells (1 μg DNA in 50 μL competent bacteria per vial).
Stir with tips 20 times and keep on ice for 5–10 min.
Transfer the bacteria into an ice pre-chilled 0.1 cm cuvette.
Electroporate using the pre-set program at 1.8 kV/ 200 ohms/25 μF.
Wash the cuvette with 1 mL pre-warm 2-YT medium three times.
Transfer the bacteria into 50 mL pre-warm 2-YT medium.
Resuspend 10 electroporated vials with 500 mL pre-warm 2-YT medium in a 2 L shake flask for large scale electroporation.
Recover the bacteria at 37°C, 200 rpm for 30 min.
Aliquot 1/105 bacteria (5 μL culture medium) from each bottle into a 1.5 mL centrifuge tube containing 995 μL fresh 2-YT medium for titration.
Perform 10-fold serial dilutions of the bacteria and plate onto 2-YT-Agar plates with 100 μg/mL ampicillin.
Select transformants by adding 100 μg/mL ampicillin and 2% glucose, shaking at 37°C, 200 rpm for 2–3 h until OD600 reaches ∼0.6–0.8.
Add M13KO7 helper phage into the cells with a multiplicity of infection (MOI) = 10:1.
Incubate at 37°C for 45 minutes, mixing every 15 minutes during incubation.
Centrifuge the bacteria at 5,000 g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend the bacterial pellet with fresh 2-YT containing 100 μg/mL ampicillin and 50 μg/mL kanamycin.
Shake at 30°C for 12-15 hours at 200 rpm.
Spin down the bacteria at 8,000 g for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Transfer the supernatant into new bottles.
Add 25% volume of PEG/NaCl solution to the supernatant and incubate on ice for 1 hour.
Centrifuge the mixture at 11,000 g for 20 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet with 50 mL ice cold DPBS per liter of culture.
Centrifuge again at 10,000 g for 10 minutes at 4°C to eliminate bacterial contamination.
Transfer all the supernatant into a new bottle.
Add 20% glycerol to the supernatant.
Aliquot into 1 mL/vial and store at -80°C for long-term storage.
Determine the phage titer by detecting OD268 (1 OD ≈ 5 × 10^12 phage).
Perform ligation with 375 μg digested pComb3X and 125 μg VH to achieve a library size greater than 10^11.
Recover approximately 150 μg of ligation DNA using the DNA Clean & Concentrator-5 kit (efficiency is about 30%).
Use 1 μg of ligation DNA for one electroporation, resulting in > 10^9 colonies per electroporation.
Perform 150 electroporations to produce a total of > 1.5 × 10^11 colonies.
Randomly pick more than 100 colonies and scale up each colony in 4 mL 2-YT medium with 100 μg/mL ampicillin, shaking at 200 rpm overnight (12-15 h).
Purify the plasmid from scaled-up cultures using a QIAprep Spin Miniprep Kit.
Elute purified plasmids with 30 μL water.
Send all plasmids for sequencing and analyze sequences.
Ensure that all VH sequences are unique, different from each other.
Clone the RBD into expression plasmid pIW-Zeo.
Transfect Expi293TM cells with pIW-Zeo-RBD plasmid overnight.
Maintain transfected cells at 37°C in an incubator shaker rotating at 135 rpm with 8% CO2 and 85% humidity for 3–7 days.
Amplify the SARS-CoV-2 RBD gene using EcoRV-RBD-P1/EcoRI-His-AviTag-P2 primers with Phusion Flash High-Fidelity PCR Master Mix according to the manufacturer’s protocol.
Run all the PCR product on a 1% agarose gel to verify the size.
Purify the PCR RBD-AviTag product from the agarose gel with QIAquick Gel Extraction Kit.
Digest the pIW-Zeo plasmid in a separate reaction.
Incubate each mixture at 37°C for 2 h.
Run a 1% agarose gel to verify the digested PCR product and plasmid bands.
Recover the digested PCR product and plasmid DNA from the agarose gel.
Elute with 10 μL water.
Ligate the digested RBD-AviTag gene into the pIW-Zeo plasmid.
Incubate the ligation reaction at 37°C for 15 min.
Transform 2 μL of the ligation reaction with 20 μL E. coli DH5α competent cells.
Recover transformed cells for 45–60 min at 37°C, shaking at 200 rpm.
Spread cells onto a 2-YT agar plate supplemented with 100 μg/mL ampicillin.
Incubate the plate in a 37°C incubator overnight (12–15 h).
Pick several colonies and scale up in 4 mL 2-YT medium with 100 μg/mL ampicillin, shaking at 200 rpm overnight (12–15 h).
Purify the plasmid using QIAprep Spin Miniprep Kit.
Elute purified plasmid with 50 μL water.
Verify the plasmid by DNA sequencing and keep correct clones.
Seed cells at a density of 2.0 × 10^6 viable cells/mL in incubator shaker rotating at 135 rpm with 8% CO2 and 85% humidity, the day before transfection.
Determine number and viability of cells using an automated cell counter on the day of transfection.
Dilute cells to 3.0 × 10^6 viable cells/mL with Expi293™ Expression Medium.
Add 27 mL cell suspension into a 125 mL Erlenmeyer shaker flask.
Return cells to the incubator.
Dilute 30 μg of plasmid DNA into 1.5 mL Expi293™ Expression Medium.
Mix gently and incubate for 5 min at room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Dilute 120 μg of PEI into 1.5 mL Expi293™ Expression Medium.
Mix gently and incubate for 5 min at room temperature (20°C–25°C).
After the 5 min incubation, mix the plasmid DNA with the PEI.
Incubate at room temperature (20°C–25°C) for 10–20 min.
Add the DNA-PEI complex into a shaker flask from step 18c.
Gently swirl the flask.
Return and incubate the cells in an incubator.
Maintain the culture for 7 days at 37°C.
Take 5 mL of transfected cells into a 50 mL centrifugation tube.
Centrifuge at 300 g for 3 minutes.
Return the supernatant to the expression bottle.
Resuspend the cells with 5 mL Expi293™ Expression Medium containing 250 μg/mL Zeocin.
Incubate the cells in the incubator.
Change the medium to fresh Expi293™ Expression Medium containing 250 μg/mL Zeocin at day 1, day 2, day 3, and day 4.
If viability is less than 30% at day 4, reduce the Zeocin concentration to 50 μg/mL for the following three days.
Change the medium to Expi293™ Expression Medium with 50 μg/mL Zeocin on day 7.
Resuspend the cells in 20 mL of this medium and transfer them into a 125 mL Erlenmeyer shaker flask.
Incubate the cells for 3-6 days to establish stable cell pools.
Prepare the Ni-NTA gravity column by transferring 1 mL His Pur™ Ni-NA Resin (10 mg protein/1 mL beads) into it.
Allow the resin to settle and drain excess buffer through the column.
Wash the resin with 20 mL of Milli Q water.
Wash the resin with 20 mL of binding buffer.
Transfer the expression medium into a 50 mL conical tube.
Spin down at 300 g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Pour the supernatant into new conical tubes.
Spin down at 12,000 g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Load all the media into the column.
Wash the column with 40 mL wash buffer once the medium has completely entered the column.
Elute the RBD-AviTag with 4 mL elution buffer.
Change buffer using DPBS and a 10 kD ultra-filter.
Follow instructions in the manufacturer’s protocol for changing buffers.
Measure the protein concentration on NanoDrop Lite.
Run SDS-PAGE gel to characterize the purified RBD-AviTag.
Check the quality of the RBD-AviTag antigen by human angiotensin-converting enzyme 2 (ACE2) binding ELISA.
Label the RBD-AviTag with BirA Biotin-Protein Ligase Kit according to the manufacturer’s protocol.
Thaw a phage library aliquot (1 mL, ≈ 5 × 10^12 phage/mL).
Add 250 μL of PEG/NaCl solution into the phage.
Incubate on ice for 20 min.
Centrifuge at 12,000 g for 10 min at 4°C.
Discard supernatant and resuspend the pellet with 200 μL DPBS.
Take 2 × 10^12 library phage diluted into 1 mL of 3% BSA-DPBS.
Add 10 μg RBD-Bio antigen to the mixture.
Rotate at room temperature (20°C–25°C) for 1.5 h.
Incubate TG1 bacterial plate or commercial stock in 20 mL 2-YT medium at 37°C, 200 rpm until OD600 ≈ 0.5.
Transfer 25 μL streptavidin beads into a 1.5 mL centrifugation tube.
Wash the beads with 1 mL DPBS twice using magnets.
Block the beads with 3% BSA-DPBS for 1 hour at room temperature (RT).
Incubate phage solution with washed streptavidin beads at 10 RPM/min for 1 hour at RT.
Wash the beads with 1 mL 0.05% PBST five times, then wash twice with DPBS after the first round of panning.
Wash the beads with 1 mL 0.05% PBST eight times, then wash twice with DPBS after the second round of panning.
Wash the beads with 1 mL 0.05% PBST fifteen times, then wash twice with DPBS after the third round of panning.
Wash the beads with 1 mL 0.05% PBST twenty times, then wash twice with DPBS after the fourth round of panning.
Resuspend beads with 5 mL TG1 cells (OD600 ≈ 0.5) in a 15 mL culture tube.
Incubate the mixture at 37°C for 45 minutes, mixing every 15 minutes.
Take 5 μL of infected TG1 cell culture into a 1.5 mL centrifuge tube containing 995 μL fresh 2-YT medium.
Serially dilute bacteria tenfold with 2-YT medium and plate 1/104, 1/105, and 1/106 of total bacteria onto 2-YT-Agar plates with 100 μg/mL ampicillin.
Add the rest to fresh 2-YT medium containing 100 μg/mL ampicillin and 2% glucose, then shake at 37°C, 200 rpm for 2 hours.
Add 10 μL M13KO7 helper phage (phage titer: 1011/mL) to the cell culture (10 μL/5 mL), incubate at 37°C for 45 minutes, mixing every 15 minutes.
Centrifuge the mixture at 4,000 g for 10 minutes at room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Discard supernatant and resuspend pellet with 50 mL 2-YT containing 100 μg/mL ampicillin and 50 μg/mL kanamycin.
Shake the culture at 30°C, 200 rpm for 12–15 hours.
Transfer cell culture into a 50 mL centrifuge tube and spin down bacteria at 8,000 g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Collect supernatant in a new 50 mL centrifuge tube and add 25% volume of PEG/NaCl solution to it.
Mix the mixture and incubate on ice for 1 hour.
Centrifuge the mixture at 11,000 g for 20 minutes.
Discard supernatant and resuspend pellet with 2 mL cold DPBS.
Separate the phage into two 1.5 mL tubes.
Centrifuge at 15,000 g for 1 minute at 4°C to eliminate bacteria.
Transfer the supernatant containing the phage to new tubes.
Determine the titer by detecting OD268 (1 OD ≈ 5 × 10^12 phage).
Do not proceed if the phage titer is lower than 10^11/mL.
Check quality of TG1 cells and M13KO7 helper phage.
Repeat first round of panning for 15 hours before purifying phage.
Add 20% glycerol to one tube and store at −80°C.
Take 10^12 phage from the other tube for next round of panning.
Use > 10^11 phage if previous purification yields less than 10^12 phage.
Pause point: Add 20% glycerol to both tubes and store at −80°C for long-term storage.
Take 1011 to 1012 previous round purified phage.
Dilute the phage into 1 mL 5% Milk-DPBS.
Incubate with 50 μL streptavidin-magnetic beads at 10 rpm for 1 hour at RT (20°C–25°C).
Clean the beads with magnets.
Use the depleted phage for the next round of panning.
Coat ELISA plates with RBD-AviTag overnight at 4°C.
Wash ELISA plates 3 times with 0.05% PBST, then block with 100 μL 5% Milk-DPBS for 2 hours.
Add 100 μL 5% Milk-DPBS diluted phage (∼1011 phage from each round) and shake 1 hour at RT (20°C–25°C).
Wash ELISA plates with 0.05% PBST, 4 times.
Add 100 μL Anti-M13 Antibody (HRP), diluted in 5% Milk-DPBS, and shake for 45 minutes at RT (20°C–25°C).
Wash ELISA plates with 0.05% PBST, 5 times.
Add 50 μL TMB into each well and allow reaction for 5 to 10 minutes.
Stop the reaction with 50 μL 2 M H2SO4.
Read optical density (OD) of the ELISA plates at 450 nm.
Add 180 μL 2-YT medium with 100 μg/mL ampicillin to each well of 96-well plate.
Pick single colony into each well.
Incubate the 96-well plates at 37°C, 200 rpm until OD600 ≈ 0.5.
Take 200 μL OD600 = 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8 TG1 cells into a 96 well plate.
Detect the OD600 with Synergy HTX Multi-Mode Reader to get a standard curve.
Compare the absorbance with the standard curve.
Once most wells reach to OD600 ≈ 0.5, add IPTG to induce VH expression.
Add 20 μL IPTG stock (10 mM) into each well to induce VH expression.
Incubate the plates at 30°C, 200 rpm for 12–15 hours.
Coat ELISA plates with RBD-AviTag (2 μg/mL in DPBS, 50 μL/well) overnight at 4°C.
Wash plates three times with 0.05% PBST.
Block the plates with 100 μL 3% BSA-DPBS for 2 hours.
Wash plates three times with 0.05% PBST.
Add 50 μL of 6% BSA-DPBS into each well of RBD-AviTag coated plates.
Spin bacteria expression plates at 4,000 g for 5 minutes at 4°C and transfer 50 μL supernatant into each well.
Shake the plates with 200 rpm/min for 2 hours at RT (20°C–25°C).
Wash plates four times with 0.05% PBST.
Add 100 μL of Monoclonal ANTI-FLAG® M2-Peroxidase (diluted 1:2500 in 3% BSA-DPBS) to each well and shake for 45 minutes at RT with 200 rpm/min.
Wash plates five times with 0.05% PBST.
Add 50 μL of TMB into each well and allow the reaction to proceed for 5–10 minutes.
Stop the reaction by adding 50 μL of 2 M H2SO4.
Read optical density (OD) at 450 nm using a microplate reader.
Take 10 μL of bacterial sample from positive wells, scale up with 2 mL 2-YT medium containing 100 μg/mL ampicillin and incubate overnight at 37°C, 200 rpm.
Purify the plasmid of selected positive clones and send for sequencing.
Keep unique sequence clones for VH preparation and characterization.
Transform HB2151 competent cells with selected plasmid DNA by heat-shock for 1 minute at 42°C.
Recover the transformed cells at 37°C, 200 rpm for 45–60 minutes.
Plate the transformed cells onto 2-YT-Agar plates containing 100 μg/mL ampicillin and 1% glucose.
Incubate the plates at 37°C overnight (12–15 hours).
Pick a single colony from the fresh plate into a 50 mL centrifuge tube with 20 mL of 2-YT medium plus 100 μg/mL ampicillin.
Incubate the tube at 37°C, 200 rpm until OD600 ≈ 0.5.
Add 20 μL IPTG stock (1 M) to each tube for a final concentration of 1 mM IPTG.
Incubate the tubes at 30°C, 200 rpm overnight (12–15 hours).
Centrifuge the bacteria at 5,000 g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend the bacterial pellet in 10 mL DPBS and add polymyxin B (5 MU for 1 L culture).
Incubate the resuspended bacteria at 37°C, 200 rpm for 30 minutes.
